"""Nov 25 update: add Nov 22-24 box scores (landofbasketball.com, each team's columns checked against the
team totals line) to the existing players_last10.json, keep each team's 10 most recent games, and refresh
opponent defensive rank/efficiency from the new team-defense file."""
import json,glob,collections,unicodedata
OLD='/home/claude/NBA-Analytics/data/players_last10.json'
DEF='team/nba_defense_2026_27.json'
P=json.load(open(OLD)); rows=P['rows']
D=json.load(open(DEF))['rows']
drk={t['team']:(t['drtg_rk'],t['drtg']) for t in D}
nm={t['team']:t['name'] for t in D}
inv={v:k for k,v in nm.items()}; inv['Los Angeles Clippers']='LAC'
# box-score abbreviations / spellings -> names already used in the app
fold=lambda s:unicodedata.normalize('NFKD',s).encode('ascii','ignore').decode().lower()
known={}
for r in rows: known.setdefault((r['team'],fold(r['player'])),r['player'])
FIX={'N. Alexander-Walker':'Nickeil Alexander-Walker','Pacome Dadiet':'Pacôme Dadiet','Bobby Portis':'Bobby Portis Jr.',
 'Alex Sarr':'Alexandre Sarr','T. Shannon Jr.':'Terrence Shannon Jr.','O. Prosper':'Olivier-Maxence Prosper',
 'K. Jakucionis':'Kasparas Jakucionis','A.J. Green':'AJ Green','C. Murray-Boyles':'Collin Murray-Boyles',
 'T. Jackson-Davis':'Trayce Jackson-Davis','S. Gilgeous-Alexander':'Shai Gilgeous-Alexander','Ron Holland II':'Ronald Holland'}
def name(team,n):
    n=FIX.get(n,n)
    return known.get((team,fold(n)),n)
new=[]
for f in sorted(glob.glob('box/*.txt')):
    L=open(f).read().strip().split('\n'); fn=f.split('/')[-1]; date=f'2026-{fn[:2]}-{fn[2:4]}'
    home=[x.split(':')[1].strip() for x in L[0].split('|') if x.strip().startswith('Home')][0].strip()
    blocks=[];cur=None
    for l in L[1:]:
        if l.startswith('TEAM:'): cur=[inv[l[5:].strip()],[]]; blocks.append(cur); continue
        p=l.split('|')
        if p[0]=='TOTALS': cur.append(int(p[2])); continue
        cur[1].append(p)
    (t1,p1,s1),(t2,p2,s2)=blocks
    for t,pl,s,o,os in [(t1,p1,s1,t2,s2),(t2,p2,s2,t1,s1)]:
        assert sum(int(x[2]) for x in pl)==s
        ha='Home' if nm[t]==home or (t=='LAC' and 'Clippers' in home) else 'Away'
        res=f"{'W' if s>os else 'L'} {s}-{os}"
        for x in pl:
            mm,ss=x[1].split(':'); v=list(map(int,x[2:10])); pn=name(t,x[0])
            new.append(dict(key=f"{t}_{pn.replace(' ','_').replace('.','')}_{date}",player=pn,team=t,team_name=nm[t],date=date,opp=o,opp_name=nm[o],
              home_away=ha,result=res,opp_def_rank=drk[o][0],opp_def_eff=drk[o][1],min=round(int(mm)+int(ss)/60),
              pts=v[0],reb=v[1],ast=v[2],stl=v[3],blk=v[4],tpm=v[5],tpa=v[6],source='landofbasketball.com',tov=v[7]))
have={(r['team'],r['date']) for r in rows}
dup={(r['team'],r['date']) for r in new}&have
assert not dup,dup
rows=rows+new
d=collections.defaultdict(set)
for r in rows: d[r['team']].add(r['date'])
keep={t:set(sorted(s,reverse=True)[:10]) for t,s in d.items()}
rows=[r for r in rows if r['date'] in keep[r['team']]]
for r in rows: r['opp_def_rank'],r['opp_def_eff']=drk[r['opp']]
# checks: points sum to final score, unique keys, 10 games per team
tot=collections.defaultdict(int);fin={}
for r in rows: k=(r['team'],r['date']); tot[k]+=r['pts']; fin[k]=int(r['result'].split()[1].split('-')[0])
assert all(tot[k]==fin[k] for k in tot),[k for k in tot if tot[k]!=fin[k]]
assert len({r['key'] for r in rows})==len(rows)
g=collections.defaultdict(set)
for r in rows: g[r['team']].add(r['date'])
assert all(len(v)==10 for v in g.values()) and len(g)==30,{k:len(v) for k,v in g.items()}
rows.sort(key=lambda r:(r['team'],r['date']))
meta=[m for m in P['meta'] if m['label']!='Inputs']
meta.append({"label":"nov25_update.py","value":open(__file__).read(),"type":"code","lang":"python"})
meta.append({"label":"Inputs","value":"Last 10 games per team for all 30 teams (300 team-games), through Nov 24, 2026 except BOS, WAS, DAL and DEN (their Nov 24 box scores weren't posted yet, so they run through Nov 22). Box scores from FantasyData (most games), plus SI.com, ESPN, NBA.com, CBS Sports, FantasyTeamAdvice and Land of Basketball (Nov 22-24 games). Every game checked: player points sum to the team's final score; Nov 22-24 games also checked column by column (REB, AST, STL, BLK, 3PM, 3PA, TOV) against the team totals. Opponent defensive rank/efficiency from the team-defense tab (ESPN opponent stats through Nov 23). Minutes rounded to the nearest minute."})
json.dump({'rows':rows,'meta':meta},open('players_last10.json','w'))
print(len(rows),'rows; new games added:',len({(r['team'],r['date']) for r in new}))
print({t:max(v) for t,v in sorted(g.items())})
